title: Retire stock OpenClaw first-run BOOTSTRAP.md and service-agent persona templates; enable skipBootstrap and re-attempt ritual-closed L2 sources

config_entry.readback_command: openclaw config get agents.defaults.skipBootstrap --json | jq -e '. == true'

bootstrap_pending_system_prompt_section.behavior: resolveWorkspaceBootstrapStatus(dir) returns 'complete' if openclaw-workspace-state.json has a non-empty setupCompletedAt string OR if BOOTSTRAP.md does not exist on disk (!await pathExists(path.join(resolvedDir, 'BOOTSTRAP.md'))); otherwise it returns 'pending'. When 'pending', buildAgentBootstrapSystemContext appends '## Bootstrap Pending' in either 'full' mode (canonical interactive workspace session: complete BOOTSTRAP.md ritual before normal task work) or 'limited' mode (non-canonical / subagent / cron / restricted-tool run: 'Bootstrap is still pending for this workspace, but this run cannot safely complete the full BOOTSTRAP.md workflow here'). Removing BOOTSTRAP.md from disk immediately sets bootstrapMode='none'.

project_context_bootstrap_file_injection.behavior: loadWorkspaceBootstrapFiles reads AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, and MEMORY.md from the workspace root. filterCompletedWorkspaceBootstrapFile drops BOOTSTRAP.md only if openclaw-workspace-state.json has setupCompletedAt; buildBootstrapContextFiles injects every remaining file that exists on disk (!file.missing) into Project Context.

why_stock_files_persisted_on_hosted_dev.behavior: Every workspace initialization path passes ensureBootstrapFiles: !agentCfg?.skipBootstrap to ensureAgentWorkspace, which seeds the 7 stock templates when missing. reconcileWorkspaceBootstrapCompletionState auto-deletes BOOTSTRAP.md only when SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, or USER.md differs from the stock template or memory/ exists. Service agents (structured-extraction, memory-index) and consult-* panels never had custom SOUL.md/IDENTITY.md/USER.md, and agora-servant-* had not run a turn after their SOUL.md was installed, leaving stock BOOTSTRAP.md on disk.

before_retirement.notes: Measured on hosted dev after the 2026-11-27 04:22Z switch with all 7 stock templates and ## Bootstrap Pending injected.

after_retirement.notes: Verified inside ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.7.1 via resolveBootstrapContextForRun; post-switch hosted ledger usage readback runs on deployment acceptance.

markers: who am i? who are you?
ac4_fixed_defect_reattempt.extractor_and_matcher_behavior: services/source_ingestion/hypothesis_card.py :: FIXED_DEFECT_REATTEMPT_OUTCOMES matches both no_hypothesis: and hypothesis_extraction_failed: ritual skip reasons via fixed_defect_for_skip_reason while rejecting genuine abstentions, and HypothesisExtractor._extract classifies any ritual-marked abstention as failed (openclaw_workspace_first_run_ritual).

ac5_discovery_pipeline_release_probe.judge_invariant: Must equal 0; any value > 0 fails hypothesis_cards with ritual_marked_events_since_switch:<count>.

runtime_budget.cadence: One-time migration during openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh; idempotent no-op on subsequent runs
runtime_budget.hosted_scale_count_and_size: At most ~60 files across 17 workspaces, <= 8 KB each, total <= 480 KB on existing openclaw-data volume
runtime_budget.growth_per_day: 0 B/day after initial retirement because agents.defaults.skipBootstrap=true stops future stock seeding
runtime_budget.cap_and_cleanup: Bounded by one-time stock file set (<= 480 KB); retained on openclaw-data volume for auditability

residual_findings.finding: Consult panel workspaces (workspaces/consult-*) still run on the stock '# SOUL.md - Who You Are' template after stock BOOTSTRAP.md is retired; Pantheon-authored consult panel SOUL.md / AGENTS.md templates belong to the persona-loop domain.

DistillationJobQueue.reattempt_fixed_defect_records in services/source_ingestion/distillation_worker.py:2770 (outside this task's declared artifacts contract) pre-filters distillation_outbox in SQL with AND skip_reason LIKE 'hypothesis_extraction_failed:%' before calling fixed_defect_for_skip_reason(row['skip_reason']); widening that SQL predicate with OR skip_reason LIKE 'no_hypothesis:%' is needed for the SQL scan to reach the 52 historical no_hypothesis rows from 2026-11-26 12:51Z..2026-11-27 05:30Z.
